name: branch8-deepwiki
description: DeepWiki as a knowledge source: the Devin MCP (mcp.devin.ai, OAuth login once via /mcp) for Branch8's own repositories indexed in Devin, and the public DeepWiki MCP (mcp.deepwiki.com, no auth) for open-source repositories. A skill tells Claude when to consult it, which server to use, how to query without flooding the context, and never to start paid Devin sessions on its own.
